newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-O/N RATES UP AHEAD OF WEEKEND, LAT SEEN EASING.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-O/N RATES UP AHEAD OF WEEKEND, LAT SEEN EASING.

text.p: Overnight rates rose ahead of the weekend and the lat/dollar rate came close to the Bank of Latvia's intervention rate on Friday.
But dealers said that the lat was expected to ease slightly in response to local market demand for dollars.
Volumes on both markets were relatively low because of the summer holiday, dealer said.
Overnight rates climbed to a bid/ask of 4.00/4.50 percent on Friday from 3.20/4.20 percent on Thursday.
Dealers said rates usually rise ahead of the weekend as banks have three days to meet their reserve requirements and expected them to fall next week.
In foreign exchange markets, the interbank lat/dollar rate was steady at 0.5699/704, near the central bank's intervention rate of 0.5696/811.
"This situation won't last as we don't expect banks to sell dollars to the central bank...There is a big order for dollars from a couple of sources right now," said one dealer.
Dealers declined to name the source.
